statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-44950 is in fs_read_glyphs() in src/fc/fserve.c, which is only compiled when XFONT_FC is enabled. Debian libxfont builds with --disable-fc in debian/rules (documented in debian/changelog since 1:1.4.7-1: font server client support disabled). The DHI package uses Debian's rules unchanged, so the font server client code is not present in the shipped libXfont2 binary.
